units.source_text: 父亲说完，又低垂头继续摆弄算盘。

en.t: After Father finished speaking, he lowered his head again and went on fiddling with the abacus.

units.source_text: 别人不理会我愿望，却让我想要实现的愿望的心情更加迫切。

en.t: Other people ignoring my wish only made my desire to see it fulfilled grow more urgent.

units.source_text: 我再次从后面摇了摇父亲的肩膀。

en.t: I shook Father by the shoulder from behind once more.
